title: Property Descriptions
description: Natural-language guidance attached to individual parameters and nested properties.
question: Do property-level descriptions survive at each capture boundary?
notes: Four capture boundaries preserve all measured property descriptions. CrewAI drops descriptions from branches inside the fixture's destination union.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: descriptions on the URI and object branches of destination.anyOf are absent from the generated args_schema.

verdict.headline: Preserved at four boundaries, partly preserved at one.
verdict.detail: CrewAI loses descriptions inside union branches while retaining the surrounding parameter guidance.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tools documenting individual parameters.
known_issues: A retained type without its property description can still leave a model unable to choose the intended value.
why: Property descriptions carry the author's parameter-level intent. Losing them can make a structurally valid tool call semantically wrong.
